transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, thank you so much for seeing me. Um, I hope I'm in the right place. Well... my supervisor at work actually suggested I come in. It's really not a huge deal, I don't think, but... I guess I have this habit of leaving my station a lot? 

Like, I'll just sort of pop up during our shift meetings or step away from the line when I'm supposed to stay put. I really don't mean to cause any trouble! I just... I kind of take off before I even think about it. But my supervisor said it's becoming a safety problem, so I really want to figure it out so I can be a good worker for them. Does that make sense?
Besides getting up and moving around, do you often find it hard to focus or stay tuned into tasks?

Um, well, I guess maybe a little bit? I mean, I really do try my best to pay attention, I promise. But sometimes... like when I have to do the inventory logs or if I'm reading the training pages for the CNC machine... I'll start out really focused. But then after just a few minutes, it's like the numbers or words just sort of blur together? 

I end up having to go back and re-read things a bunch of times because I realize I didn't actually take any of it in. It's probably just me being a little tired from the shift, right? I really hope that doesn't make me sound like a bad employee, I do try really hard to get it right. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Looking back, did you experience these kinds of difficulties with paying attention or sitting still when you were a child, before the age of 12?

Oh, um... yeah. I guess it's always been kind of a thing for me? I really hate to admit it, because I always wanted to be a good student, I really did. But even back in elementary school, I was sort of... well, I was the kid who just couldn't stay in my seat. 

I didn't mean to be bad or disrespectful! I just had a lot of energy, I think? Sometimes I would accidentally talk over the teacher, or... or I'd get notes sent home because I'd blurt things out or just kind of wander around the room during lessons. I always felt so terrible when they had to correct me, because I really wanted them to like me. I just got a little too eager sometimes, I guess? Is that what you were asking about?
